lams.name: Addresses
lams.desc: Returns the A1 address of every cell in a range

lams.name: Alphabet
lams.desc: Returns A to Z as a 26-row array

lams.name: ArrayShift
lams.desc: Shifts an array by rows and columns, either filling the gap or wrapping it round

lams.name: ArrowsLookup
lams.desc: Normalises an arrow glyph or compass abbreviation into one consistent form

lams.name: BiCol
lams.desc: Applies a function to each column, allowing it to return an array (BYCOL that tolerates arrays)

lams.name: Biggest
lams.desc: Returns the LABEL belonging to the nth largest or smallest number, with an optional tie-break key

lams.name: BiRow
lams.desc: Applies a function to each row, allowing it to return an array (BYROW that tolerates arrays)

lams.name: BoardGameMove
lams.desc: Laps a counter round a board numbered 1 to N: past the last space it carries on from 1

lams.name: Bounce
lams.desc: Returns a run of positions that reflect off a lower and upper wall

lams.name: ByColA
lams.desc: Like BYCOL, but each column's result can be a whole array; the results sit side by side

lams.name: ByRectangle
lams.desc: Applies a function to every rectangular window of a range

lams.name: ByRowA
lams.desc: Like BYROW, but each row's result can be a whole array; the results are stacked top to bottom

lams.name: CardSets
lams.desc: Finds sets or runs in a hand, with ace-high, ace-low, wrap-around and custom rank orders

lams.name: Clamp
lams.desc: Keeps a number, or every number in an array, between an optional lower and upper bound

lams.name: ClosestOnMap
lams.desc: Returns the nearest matching item on a grid with its value, address and distance

lams.name: Coins
lams.desc: Returns how many of each denomination greedily makes up a target, largest first

lams.name: ColNum
lams.desc: Converts an A1 address, or a packed row/column number, to its column number

lams.name: Combinations
lams.desc: Lists the ways of choosing c items from a set, ordered or unordered, with or without repeats

lams.name: Consecutives
lams.desc: Returns how long the current run of identical values is, at every position

lams.name: CountEachUniqueValue
lams.desc: Returns unique values in array except any exclude values and count of how many of each, sorted by highest count.

lams.name: CountOcc
lams.desc: Counts occurrences of a character or substring within text, optionally case-sensitive

lams.name: CROSSJOIN
lams.desc: Pairs every row of one table with every row of another (every combination), keeping headers

lams.name: Dice
lams.desc: Decodes dice glyphs into their pip values, listed or totalled

lams.name: Distance
lams.desc: Returns the distance between two cells with independent horizontal, vertical and diagonal step costs, or as straight-line or knight moves; it ignores the map

lams.name: DistFrom
lams.desc: Returns how far every cell is from the nearest cell holding a given VALUE, under any metric you supply

lams.name: Duplicates
lams.desc: Returns the values that appear more than once, or the repeated letters of a single piece of text

lams.name: ExactUnique
lams.desc: Returns the distinct values, or only those appearing exactly once

lams.name: ExcludeCols
lams.desc: Returns an array with the named columns removed (CHOOSECOLS by exclusion)

lams.name: Exists
lams.desc: Returns TRUE where an item is found in a list, with an optional substring mode

lams.name: ExtractLetters
lams.desc: Splits out the letters in mixed text, joined up or as separate runs

lams.name: ExtractLowerLetters
lams.desc: Splits out only the lower-case letters in mixed text, joined up or as separate runs

lams.name: ExtractNumbers
lams.desc: Splits out the numbers in mixed text, optionally keeping decimals whole

lams.name: ExtractUpperLetters
lams.desc: Splits out only the capital letters in mixed text, joined up or as separate runs

lams.name: Fetch
lams.desc: Returns the value at an address or packed row/column number, read from a named range or block

lams.name: FillFromAbove
lams.desc: Replaces values in cells that meet criterion function with value of cell from above. If no criterion, uses blank cells.

lams.name: FillFromBelow
lams.desc: Replaces values in cells that meet criterion function with value of cell from below. If no criterion, uses blank cells.

lams.name: FillFromLeft
lams.desc: Replaces values in cells that meet criterion function with value of cell from left. If no criterion, uses blank cells.

lams.name: FillFromRight
lams.desc: Replaces values in cells that meet criterion function with value of cell from right. If no criterion, uses blank cells.

lams.name: FilterArray
lams.desc: Keeps the rows whose chosen columns all match one of the given filter values

lams.name: FindInMap
lams.desc: Returns the A1 address of every cell in a grid holding a given value

lams.name: Flip
lams.desc: Mirrors an array left-to-right, top-to-bottom or in either diagonal, optionally carrying addresses through the same flip

lams.name: Fold
lams.desc: Folds an array along an arrow, with characters that pass through instead of colliding

lams.name: GetBlock
lams.desc: Gets a block of cells in a range or array based on an address and block size

lams.name: GridToCol
lams.desc: Converts a grid to a single column with the row number, column number, address and packed coordinate of each cell, or just the columns asked for, reading along the rows or down the columns

lams.name: GroupByFirstNColumns
lams.desc: Groups by the first n columns and totals the rest (SUM unless told otherwise)

lams.name: HugWall
lams.desc: Follows a wall around a grid by the left-hand or right-hand rule

lams.name: IfBlank
lams.desc: Replaces each blank cell with the values specified.

lams.name: InsertCols
lams.desc: Given an array, inserts a second array at a specified column index.

lams.name: IsAll
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if all elements of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: IsAllButOne
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if all but one elements of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: IsAny
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if any elements of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: IsExactlyOne
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if exactly one element of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: IsExactlyTwo
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if exactly two elements of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: IsInList
lams.desc: Returns a boolean for matches in an array to a list

lams.name: IsNone
lams.desc: Returns TRUE if none of the elements of array are TRUE or meet criterion if specified.

lams.name: KnapSackInteger
lams.desc: Returns the best total value that fits a weight capacity, or which items to take

lams.name: Lag
lams.desc: Return the array shifted back by the specified number of positions.

lams.name: LeastFrequentValue
lams.desc: Returns the value that appears least often in an array, optionally skipping some values

lams.name: LETStack
lams.desc: Shows a LET step's name above its value, trimmed to a size — to see every step of a LET at once

lams.name: LetterType
lams.desc: Returns a code for each character: U upper case, L lower case, S anything else; or V vowel / C consonant; or L letter / D digit

lams.name: LineOfSight
lams.desc: Returns what a cell can see across a grid, with blockers stopping the view

lams.name: LineOfSightCount
lams.desc: Counts how many of a given item are visible from a cell

lams.name: MapOffsets
lams.desc: For each cell, applies a function to its neighbours at the given row and column offsets

lams.name: MassSubstitute
lams.desc: Applies a whole list of substitutions to text in one pass, with regex and case-sensitive modes

lams.name: MAXLOOKUP
lams.desc: Returns the item lined up with the MAX of a range

lams.name: Maze
lams.desc: Returns which cells can be reached from a starting cell, obeying walls

lams.name: MazeDistance
lams.desc: Returns the shortest distance across a grid, obeying walls. Weighted, so it takes the cheapest route rather than the fewest steps

lams.name: MINLOOKUP
lams.desc: Returns the item lined up with the MIN of a range

lams.name: MissingLetters
lams.desc: Returns the letters of the alphabet, or of any other complete set, that do not appear in a list

lams.name: ModeSuper
lams.desc: Returns the most frequent value AND how many times it appears

lams.name: MostFrequentValue
lams.desc: Returns the most frequent value in an array.

lams.name: MoveOnMap
lams.desc: Walks a direction across a grid, stopping, gliding, bouncing or wrapping at obstacles, and optionally returning the whole path

lams.name: NetworkGraph
lams.desc: Returns the cheapest (or dearest) route over an origin/destination edge table, with its cost or its route

lams.name: NotInList
lams.desc: Returns the items of a list that do not appear in another list

lams.name: nSet
lams.desc: Returns the values found in both arrays (their intersection), each once

lams.name: OffsetA
lams.desc: Returns a block offset within an array, padding rather than stepping outside it (a non-volatile OFFSET)

lams.name: OptimiseTSP
lams.desc: Improves a greedy tour and returns its cost and route

lams.name: PerCom
lams.desc: Lists the permutations or combinations of c items chosen from n

lams.name: Prev
lams.desc: Shifts a list by n places so each row can see an earlier one, filling the gap it opens

lams.name: RCRefConvert
lams.desc: Converts between an A1 address and a packed row/column number, and decodes an arrow glyph into the packed step it means

lams.name: Regions
lams.desc: Labels each connected region of a grid, so separate areas can be counted or told apart

lams.name: RegPattern
lams.desc: Builds a regular expression that matches any word in a list, longest first

lams.name: RemoveBlanks
lams.desc: Removes blank rows and columns from array as specified by remove_rows and remove_columns. Default: TRUE, TRUE.

lams.name: RemoveCols
lams.desc: Removes specified columns of array using RemoveCols lambda.

lams.name: RemoveRows
lams.desc: Returns all rows of array except the ones specified in row_indexes.

lams.name: ReverseColumns
lams.desc: Returns array with columns in reverse order.

lams.name: ReverseRows
lams.desc: Returns array with rows in reverse order.

lams.name: RGBtoColorName
lams.desc: Converts RGB integers to nearest color name in a table of 139 colors.

lams.name: Rotate
lams.desc: Turns an array through quarter turns, optionally carrying addresses through the same rotation

lams.name: RowNum
lams.desc: Converts an A1 address, or a packed row/column number, to its row number

lams.name: RunningCount
lams.desc: Returns which occurrence of its own value each item is

lams.name: RunningProduct
lams.desc: Returns a running product of an array of values in same dimensions.

lams.name: RunningTotal
lams.desc: Running total that can restart at chosen rows, and cap or stop at a limit

lams.name: RunningTotalsByColumn
lams.desc: Returns a running sum of each column of an array of values.

lams.name: RunningTotalsByRow
lams.desc: Returns a running sum of each row of an array of values.

lams.name: ScanA
lams.desc: Like SCAN, but each step can return a whole row or column; the running results are stacked

lams.name: ShiftText
lams.desc: Shifts each letter along the alphabet, optionally by an amount that grows with its position

lams.name: Snake
lams.desc: Reads a grid in serpentine order, reversing direction on alternate lines

lams.name: SplitByCharacter
lams.desc: Separates each text value in text_vector in separate cells by character.

lams.name: SplitNumbersFromText
lams.desc: Separates each text value in text_vector into separate cells by text versus numeric values.

lams.name: SplitText
lams.desc: Splits text into characters, or into fixed or overlapping groups of characters

lams.name: StackSheets
lams.desc: Turns many same-shaped sheets into one table, one row per cell, carrying the sheet name and the cell's address, row, column and packed coordinate

lams.name: SumByColumn
lams.desc: Returns sum of each column of an array of values.

lams.name: SumByRow
lams.desc: Returns sum of each row of an array of values.

lams.name: TILE
lams.desc: Applies a function to each value in a grid and tiles the resulting arrays together in that layout

lams.name: Timer
lams.desc: Times a formula: how many seconds it took to calculate, optionally with its result below

lams.name: TSPFull
lams.desc: Returns the cost of the exact shortest tour over a distance matrix

lams.name: TSPGreedy
lams.desc: Returns the cost of a nearest-neighbour tour over a distance matrix

lams.name: UngroupColumn
lams.desc: Splits a column of delimited lists into one row per item, repeating the other columns

lams.name: UnPivot
lams.desc: Converts a wide block into a long one, repeating the key columns once per value

lams.name: UnSplivot
lams.desc: Splits a delimited column and unpivots it in one step, repeating the other columns for each token

lams.name: UnTile
lams.desc: Cuts an array into tiles of a given size and applies a function to each, one result per tile

lams.name: uSet
lams.desc: Returns every value found in either array (their union), each once

lams.name: VStacks
lams.desc: Repeats a block n times, stacked or side by side

lams.name: WhileIterations
lams.desc: Repeats a step until a condition holds and returns how many steps it took

lams.name: WhileLoop
lams.desc: Repeats a step until a condition holds and returns the final state

lams.name: XLOOKUP2D
lams.desc: Looks up a value by row key and column key together

lams.name: YouAreHere
lams.desc: Converts a cell to its A1 address as text, optionally sheet-qualified

cmds.name: Align Array to Right

cmds.desc: Create Filter formula based on top row spill range formula.

cmds.name: Exclude Examples
cmds.desc: Trims the worked-example rows off the top of the selection, leaving just the real questions

cmds.desc: Select formula cells in selection with similar formula as active cell.

cmds.desc: Group by first N columns and concat remaining columns with specified delimiter.

cmds.desc: Group by first N columns and sum remaining columns.

Keep First N Rows Of Array
Keep Last N Columns Of Array
Keep Last N Rows Of Array

cmds.desc: Merged Cells changed to Centre Across Selection

cmds.name: Running Total
cmds.desc: Wraps the active array in a running total (RunningTotal with nothing else set)

cmds.name: Running Total with Cap
cmds.desc: Running total that stops at the COPIED limit and holds there (Cap = 1). Change the final 1 to 0 to keep the crossing row's full value instead

cmds.name: Running Total with Reset
cmds.desc: Running total that restarts wherever the COPIED flag range holds 1; asks what it restarts at (blank = 0). The flagged row's own value is included

cmds.name: Save Answer To Bonus 1
cmds.desc: Links the active cell (any sheet) into the Bonus 1 answer cell, goes there and copies it for the submission site.

cmds.name: Save Answer To Bonus 2
cmds.desc: Links the active cell (any sheet) into the Bonus 2 answer cell, goes there and copies it for the submission site.

cmds.name: Save Answer To Bonus 3
cmds.desc: Links the active cell (any sheet) into the Bonus 3 answer cell, goes there and copies it for the submission site.

cmds.name: Save Answer To Bonus 4
cmds.desc: Links the active cell (any sheet) into the Bonus 4 answer cell, goes there and copies it for the submission site.

cmds.name: Save Answer To Bonus 5
cmds.desc: Links the active cell (any sheet) into the Bonus 5 answer cell, goes there and copies it for the submission site.

cmds.name: Save Answers To Left
cmds.desc: Saves references to the selected cells in the green answer cells to the left on the same row.

cmds.name: Save Copy of File
cmds.desc: Enable editing and save copy of file with suffix based on active cell (otherwise Working)

cmds.name: Save From Example
cmds.desc: Select your answer formula on the example row; the working right of the inputs is copied to every question and the answers linked

cmds.name: Save Game Answers To Left
cmds.desc: Saves references to the selected cells in the green answer cells to the left on the same row.

cmds.name: Search Workbook For Specified Functions
cmds.desc: Searches cells, names, and conditional formatting for use of user specified functions and reports findings.

cmds.name: Search Workbook For Volatile Functions
cmds.desc: Searches cells, names, and conditional formatting for use of volatile functions and reports findings.

cmds.name: Select Spill Parent
cmds.desc: Select dynamic array formula cell. If no spill in ActiveCell then do nothing.

cmds.name: Sequence of Row Count
cmds.desc: Sequence of row count of array variable

cmds.name: Set Lambda Library
cmds.desc: Points CompBot at YOUR lambda library workbook, once; ILL and Full Setup Case then load it

cmds.name: Set Solve Folder
cmds.desc: Choose the folder Full Setup Case saves your _Solve copy into, once (e.g. OneDrive)

cmds.name: Setup Case Settings
cmds.desc: Opens CompBot's Setup Settings sheet: choose which steps Full Setup Case runs, and whose lambdas win a name clash

cmds.name: Show Bonus Dock
cmds.desc: Shows the open bonus questions in a dock on the right; answered ones drop off

cmds.name: Show Formula Text
cmds.desc: Show formula text of active cell in a specified adjacent cell.

cmds.name: Snake Array
cmds.desc: Uses selection within array to determine starting cell and direction.

cmds.name: Split Numbers From Text To Columns
Split Text by Delimiter Above
cmds.desc: Splits the active cell's text DOWN into rows on the delimiter in the cell above (linked, so changing that cell re-splits), and trims each piece

cmds.name: Split Text by Semicolon
cmds.desc: Splits the active cell's text on semicolons into an array, trimming each piece

cmds.name: Stack Sheets From Clipboard
cmds.desc: Stacks the same block from many sheets into one table, driven by a sheet-name list in the clipboard

cmds.name: Stack Sheets From Clipboard, Hide Blanks
cmds.desc: As Stack Sheets From Clipboard, but drops empty cells. WARNING: it drops zeros too

cmds.name: Stop Walk Route
cmds.desc: Ends a walk route by hand and writes it out, for when a diagonal click is awkward to reach

cmds.name: Sum False
cmds.desc: Counts the FALSE (0) values in an array: how many rows fail the test. Anything non-zero, such as 2 from an OR built with +, counts as TRUE

cmds.name: Sum True
cmds.desc: Counts the TRUE values in an array (applies -- and sums it): the usual way to answer 'how many rows pass this test'

cmds.name: Time Formula
cmds.desc: Wraps formula in active cell with Timer lambda to evaluate calculation performance.

cmds.name: Toggle Calculation Mode
cmds.desc: Toggles calculation mode and places current mode notice in StatusBar

cmds.name: Toggle Expand Formula Bar
cmds.desc: If formula bar height is 1 then autofit it otherwise make it 1.

cmds.name: Toggle Iterative Calculation
cmds.desc: Toggles iterative calculation and sets status in status bar

cmds.name: Transpose Array
cmds.desc: Swaps the selected array's rows and columns

cmds.name: Ungroup Column By Delimiter
cmds.desc: Splits the values in the selected column and expands the other columns.

cmds.name: Unique Columns Of Array
cmds.desc: Keeps only the distinct columns of the selected array

cmds.name: Unique Rows Of Array
cmds.desc: Keeps only the distinct rows of the selected array

cmds.name: Unmerge Multi-Row Merges
cmds.desc: Unmerges every merged area spanning more than one row (the selection, or the whole sheet), leaving the value in the top-left cell

cmds.name: Unpivot Array
cmds.desc: Turns a wide table (a column per category) into a long list: one row per value

cmds.name: Unpivot Array (By Selected Columns)
cmds.desc: Unpivots a table, turning only the selected columns into rows

cmds.name: Update Settings
cmds.desc: Updates default settings to those in Regional Settings sheet

cmds.name: Wrap Flat List Into Grid
cmds.desc: Folds a single row or column back into a grid of a chosen width, the missing half of Reshape To One Row/Column

cmds.name: Wrap in ABS
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in ABS() to make the result positive: distances, differences, gaps, reflections

cmds.name: Wrap in Concat
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in CONCAT() to join an array into one string with no separator, rebuilding a word from its letters

cmds.name: Wrap in Drop First Row
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in DROP(...,1) to remove a header row from a spilled array

cmds.name: Wrap in Take by Copied Cell Columns
cmds.desc: Wrap in take by copied cell columns.

cmds.name: Wrap in UNICHAR
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in UNICHAR() to turn code numbers back into characters: decoding glyphs, emoji or dice faces

cmds.name: Wrap in UNICODE
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in UNICODE() to turn characters into their code numbers, the first step in most cipher and glyph puzzles

cmds.name: Wrap in UNIQUE
cmds.desc: Wraps the active formula in UNIQUE() to strip duplicates: distinct values, distinct colors, distinct answers

cmds.name: Wrap with IFERROR TEXTBEFORE space
cmds.desc: Wraps current formula with TEXTBEFORE space with IFERROR in case space doesn't exist
